items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: And I played at a couple times with him

ctx.x: In Benny Kruger's band. So then he had spent a time after that working at WGN. He'd left the theater and he was directing Goldkett's band at WGN. They had to be on account of Sunday night. And I played at a couple times with him, you follow me?
